propositions: Bare import of alert_dedup in scripts/canary_bridge.py and scripts/dependency_audit.py fails when test files are run as subsets because scripts/ is not on sys.path, though full CI passes due to sys.path pollution from conftest.py

Module resolution must be invocation-independent and work under python scripts/x.py, pytest, and importlib.util.spec_from_file_location without changing the package structure or making scripts a real package
All bare sibling imports under scripts/ that reference modules in scripts/ or tests/ must be guarded by an explicit sys.path.insert derived from __file__ placed immediately above the import

A new AST-based guard test scripts/unit/test_scripts_import_convention.py must enforce that every bare sibling import in scripts/ is preceded by its sys.path insert and verify subset test collection succeeds
